models.name: Infrastructure Priority Index
limitations: Computed from ARCUS historical data and province-level public hazard overlay signals.
Live geospatial WMS/API joins are not included in Professional v0.
Sparse territories may be sensitive to individual events.

models.name: Source Reliability Indicator
limitations: Does not automatically verify source content.
Source role classification depends on curated metadata.

models.name: Event Vulnerability Model
limitations: Not a predictive structural safety model.
Infrastructure condition and inspection data are not yet included.

models.name: Asset Priority Indicator
models.output: 0-100 screening priority indicator and Priority 1/2/3/Baseline class
limitations: Asset inventory quality strongly affects results.
Professional v0 uses province-level public hazard overlay signals; asset-level live joins are Enterprise functionality.

models.name: Event Similarity Engine
models.output: 0-100 similarity indicator with explanatory match reasons
limitations: Similarity is rule-based, not machine learned.
It identifies technical precedents, not causal equivalence.
